edges.sentence: On 2026-10-03, Al Jazeera reported “previously barred from flying over alleged extremist views”; on the same day, Deutsche Welle reported “The Wall Street Journal report said the co-pilot was hired by Flydubai despite the ban by Oman, allowing him to fly the jet on a sensitive route connecting the UAE and Israel.”.

On 2026-10-03, Al Jazeera reported “previously barred from flying over alleged extremist views”; on the same day, Deutsche Welle reported “US broadcaster CNN cited two sources saying the co-pilot was removed from a job at Oman's national airline last year over concerns about extremist views.”.

On 2026-10-03, Deutsche Welle reported “The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday that he had been barred from flying by Oman over concerns that he had adopted radical ideological views.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “previously barred from flying over alleged extremist views”.

On 2026-10-03, Deutsche Welle reported “The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday that he had been barred from flying by Oman over concerns that he had adopted radical ideological views.”; on the same day, Deutsche Welle reported “The Wall Street Journal report said the co-pilot was hired by Flydubai despite the ban by Oman, allowing him to fly the jet on a sensitive route connecting the UAE and Israel.”.
